scope: Source-backed representative methods from the structural-priors survey section. Tags describe documented roles, not universal capability or runtime qualification. Untagged means not assessed in this focused pass.

features.label: Symmetric initialization
features.description: Generate ordered starting structures; symmetry may change later.

features.label: Wyckoff / site assignments
features.description: Choose compatible orbit multiplicities, species and free coordinates.

features.label: Symmetry-preserving exploration
features.description: Enforce crystallographic constraints during a proposal or search stage.

features.label: Symmetry hierarchy / diversity
features.description: Allocate exploration among symmetry classes or retain multiple classes.

features.label: Topology / connectivity
features.description: Use periodic nets or graph fragments, rather than only coordinates.

features.label: Molecular units / chemical motifs
features.description: Construct and vary reusable molecules, fragments or modules.

features.label: Prototypes / substitution
features.description: Transfer known structural arrangements and chemical substitutions.

features.label: Cation / occupation ordering
features.description: Enumerate symmetry-distinct decorations of a parent lattice.

features.label: Chemical / geometric plausibility
features.description: Use separation, coordination or chemical-compatibility constraints.

profiles.name: USPEX: symmetric initialization and variation
profiles.role: Initialize symmetric candidates and favor useful local environments in variation.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Initial symmetry may change through variation and relaxation.
profiles.limitations: This is not a permanently fixed-space-group search.

profiles.name: CALYPSO: construction and duplicate control
profiles.role: Combine symmetric generation, swarm search and bond-based duplicate rejection.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Construction symmetry and subsequent symmetry handling are separate settings.
profiles.limitations: Same symmetry or energy alone does not establish structural identity.

profiles.name: SPAI / CALYPSO divide-and-conquer
profiles.role: Explore a hierarchy of space groups, Wyckoff combinations and coordinates using bee-colony-inspired roles.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Preserves symmetry during evolution; reported scheme excludes P1.
profiles.limitations: Crystallographic subspaces, not independently optimized spatial pieces. Excluding P1 restricts coverage.

profiles.name: RandSpg
profiles.role: Generate compatible Wyckoff occupations and reject unsuitable distances.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Specified symmetry at construction.
profiles.limitations: A constructor, not a complete energy-ranking search.

profiles.name: PyXtal
profiles.role: Construct atomic or molecular crystals with compatible site symmetry.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Space, layer, rod and point-group construction; molecular site compatibility.
profiles.limitations: Atom counts, cell setting and molecular orientations must be compatible.

profiles.name: Topology-based USPEX generator
profiles.role: Decorate idealized periodic nets to create candidates for a target stoichiometry.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Net embedding and group relations guide candidate construction.
profiles.limitations: Net-library and decoration coverage limit exploration; topology differs from geometry.

profiles.name: MAGUS: graph fragments and symmetry mining
profiles.role: Combine graph decomposition with later space-group mining, fragment reorganization and symmetry-preserving mutation.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Global symmetry and local fragments guide the evolving search.
profiles.limitations: Source archive is public, but its academic-use terms are not an open-source license.

profiles.name: Constrained molecular USPEX
profiles.role: Treat molecular units as whole objects in construction and variation.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Symmetric packing initialization with unit positions and orientations.
profiles.limitations: Fixed units can exclude dissociation or changes in bonding.

profiles.name: MC-EMMA
profiles.role: Assemble chemically informed modules for exploration of complex phase fields.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Modular construction does not require a single prescribed space group.
profiles.limitations: The available modules constrain representable chemistry.

profiles.name: FUSE / FUSE2
profiles.role: Build and rearrange cation–anion modules with stacking and coordination rules.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Approximate lattice types do not impose full internal symmetry.
profiles.limitations: Motif restrictions may exclude unusual coordination or reconstructive changes.

profiles.name: Data-mined ionic substitution
profiles.role: Learn likely ionic substitutions while transferring a known structure type.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Inherited template geometry may change during relaxation.
profiles.limitations: Substitution alone does not specify every ordered site decoration.

profiles.name: TCSP / TCSP2
profiles.role: Select and chemically adapt template structures for a specified composition.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Template occupations and geometry provide the starting arrangement.
profiles.limitations: Template coverage differs from unconstrained topology discovery.

profiles.name: CSPML
profiles.role: Use learned similarity to retrieve structural templates.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Symmetry is inherited through candidate templates.
profiles.limitations: A missing prototype may be difficult to recover by local relaxation.

profiles.name: Derivative-structure enumeration / enumlib
profiles.role: Enumerate distinct parent-lattice occupations while removing symmetry-equivalent arrangements.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Decorations may lower parent symmetry or require supercells.
profiles.limitations: Completeness holds only within the chosen parent and cell-size bounds.

profiles.name: AIRSS / buildcell
profiles.role: Sample plausible starts using volume, separation, symmetry and structural-unit information.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Construction constraints are selected for the system and workflow.
profiles.limitations: Chemical constraints are domain-dependent, particularly under pressure.

profiles.name: CMCrystalHS
profiles.role: Use PyXtal assignments and differential evolution over free Wyckoff coordinates.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Supplied symmetry and a contact-map objective constrain reconstruction.
profiles.limitations: Descriptor-assisted reconstruction supplies more information than formula-only prediction.

profiles.name: CRYSIM
profiles.role: Encode space group, Wyckoff assignments and independent coordinates for optimization.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Separate discrete crystallographic choices from positional variables.
profiles.limitations: Results depend on encoding bounds and the energy evaluator.

profiles.name: DiffCSP++
profiles.role: Constrain lattice and coordinate diffusion using crystallographic symmetry.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Symmetry-compatible lattice representation and Wyckoff constraints.
profiles.limitations: Symmetry conditioning is additional information; exact formula requires compatible counts.

profiles.name: CrystalFormer
profiles.role: Generate symmetry-inequivalent site sequences; support symmetry control and substitution workflows.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Reconstruct complete crystals from space group and site information.
profiles.limitations: Original generation and later formula-conditioned CSP interfaces must be distinguished.

profiles.name: SymmCD
profiles.role: Learn asymmetric-unit information together with its symmetry transformations.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Symmetry enters the generative variables rather than only geometric equivariance.
profiles.limitations: Symmetry-aware generation alone does not establish exact formula conditioning.

profiles.name: ParetoCSP2
profiles.role: Control space-group diversity within age–fitness evolutionary search.
profiles.symmetry_behavior: Retain multiple symmetry classes across a population.
profiles.limitations: Different polymorphs can share the same space group.
